digest.component_or_area: event store compaction and sweep scheduling
propositions: Compaction must be triggered automatically in environments lacking CI and local cron to prevent unbounded event log growth.
The scheduled 6-hourly sweep's per-ticket git log walks are lock-held and unscalable, requiring hoisting outside the critical section and batching via a single sweep-wide history map.
A detached operation-linked fallback must coexist with the scheduled sweep so closing a ticket triggers compaction out-of-band without holding the store lock across fold or LLM operations.

Selection for re-compaction of already-snapshotted tickets must account for foldable event count against the 30-minute horizon, not raw live count, to avoid selecting tickets whose excess is all too-young and would fold to nothing.
Advisory locks using stamped-file ownership must prevent concurrent compactors from racing while respecting mid-sweep re-yield to foreground writers.
